mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, address_id, total_amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{addressId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 1, pay_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status IN (1,2,3,4)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3,4)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS num FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orders, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,4) THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
